title: ICU Staff Nurse
description:
ICU Staff Nurse - Harbourview General Hospital

Harbourview General Hospital is hiring nurses for its expanding critical care unit.

Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat (On-site) | Experience: 2+ years

What you will do:
- Provide safe, compassionate nursing care
- Monitor and document patient condition
- Work with doctors and the care team

What we are looking for:
- Registered Nurse (State Nursing Council registration)
- Patient care and medication administration
- BLS
- 2+ years: clinical nursing experience
- B.Sc Nursing or GNM
- Willing to work rotating night shifts

Nice to have:
- ACLS
- Critical care

What we offer:
- Health insurance for you and your family
- Hybrid working (3 days in office)
- Annual learning budget
- Performance bonus

Harbourview General Hospital is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every gender, religion, caste, disability and background.

requirements.description: Willing to work rotating night shifts

title: Backend Engineer (Java)
description:
Backend Engineer (Java) - Jalwave Networks

We are looking for a backend engineer to build and run the services behind our payments and lending products at Jalwave Networks. You will own APIs end to end - design, code, tests, release and on-call.

Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh (On-site) | Experience: 3+ years

What you will do:
- Design, build and operate Java services that handle millions of transactions
- Review code and raise the bar on testing
- Work with product managers to break down features
- Improve reliability, latency and cost of the platform

What we are looking for:
- Strong hands-on experience with Java
- Spring Boot
- Relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL
- 3+ years: professional backend development experience
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field

Nice to have:
- Kafka
- AWS or Azure
- AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate
- Able to join within 30 days

What we offer:
- Health insurance for you and your family
- Hybrid working (3 days in office)
- Annual learning budget
- Performance bonus

Jalwave Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every gender, religion, caste, disability and background.
